title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
about: A laundromat owner drowning in tax paperwork finds she can jump between universes to save the multiverse.
cue: Serve the bagel bites when the everything bagel shows up.
faces: Open 11 am till late, every day.
+ Evelyn and Joy as two rocks
I put googly eyes on the dumplings. Everyone gets one, and Evelyn gets two.
Mini bagels with spring onion cream cheese and everything seasoning.
Pan-fried then steamed, with black vinegar and chilli oil.
Hot dog fingers in puff pastry
Thin frankfurts in cheddar puff strips, baked flaky, mustard to dunk, eaten with your feet.
Lap cheong sticky rice in lotus leaf
Hibachi steak and prawn fried rice
Seared sirloin and prawns with zucchini, egg fried rice, garlic butter.
Longevity noodles with chicken and shiitake
Long egg noodles wok tossed with thigh, bok choy and oyster sauce, never cut.
Fried glutinous rice balls coated in sesame, filled with red bean paste.
Chilled black milk tea with brown sugar tapioca pearls.
Be kind, especially when we don't know what's going on.
The lot in one bag, at your door before the trailers end.
Kitchen tip: Serve the bagel bites when the everything bagel shows up. Overheard: Deirdre the IRS auditor. Prices subject to change. Form TK 22. Poster and stills: TMDB.
